shared_elements: upright rectangular carved monolith/pillar as the decorated field
relief carving covering the whole face of an upright slab
repeated row of similar elements across the top
justification: Both are upright slabs carved in relief with content stacked in vertical tiers, and both include profile animal forms and a repeated row of similar motifs near the top, but these are generic to monumental relief. A depicts sparse, isolated, schematic animals (quadrupeds, birds, a snake-like sinuous form) on largely empty ground, whereas B is dominated by a frontal, elaborately costumed human figure with a large face and dense interlocking ornament filling every space, with no shared specific motif or relationship.
